title: Drawing Foundations
tagline: Train your eye and hand from first marks to a durable daily practice.
curricula: Classical atelier training, Drawabox, and Betty Edwards' Drawing on the Right Side of the Brain
endpoint: from first marks to a durable daily drawing practice
about: Drawing is a trainable coordination of eye and hand — learning to see what is actually there and to put it on paper with intent. This category walks the classical fundamentals in order: contour and line, construction from basic forms, value and light, perspective, gesture, and composition, sustained by the daily practice that makes each of them stick.
